title: next-semver configuration
description: Optional .semver.json config for next-semver.sh, customizing which commit types produce which Bump Type.

$schema.description: Optional reference to this schema file, for editor autocomplete/validation. Never inspected by next-semver.sh.

rules.description: Maps a commit-type keyword (e.g. "feat") to the Bump Type it produces. A key overrides a built-in of the same name (feat, fix); any other key adds a new rule. "none" means that commit type contributes no bump.
